Context: Medical claims requiring opinion of specialists

- OM, dated 14-5-2018.  
- (i) CGHS beneficiaries who have subscribed to Medical Insurance Policies can claim reimbursement both from Insurance Company and CGHS / Department subject to condition that the reimbursement should not exceed the total expenditure on treatment. - OM, dated 19-2-2009.
